title: MV "Aporia Aegis Antechamber," a story-focused, single-screen dungeon crawler.

posts.author: Dusk_Funa
posts.body:
This game contains light gore and suggestive character designs, making it unsuitable for those aged below 15.
Aporia Aegis Antechamber is a high fantasy, lite-RPG dungeon crawler set in the fictional world of Viridia, populated by humanoid sentients named Lanir, and many other creatures. There exists a labyrinth hidden in a clearing deep within a notorious forest, having caught the attention of adventurers from far and wide due to its reputation of never having been conquered, none even knowing its creator or purpose. In this game, you must brace yourself as you take 100 steps within the maddening labyrinth. Control Sybil and his loyal servant Elohi as they venture into it thanks only to Sybil's hubris.​
Features:
Story-rich, simplistic duel simulation, single-screen dungeon crawling;
Short playtime of upwards to an hour and a half, delivering a complete tale that still leaves questions behind;
No branching endings.
Trailer and screenshots
Spoiler
Within main game exploration, there is only a single screen. The player may either press "Forward" to progress further, or "Mud Exit" to return to the game's hub. There is no option to retrace one's steps. Within game exploration, the player may randomly come across one of three things: An event, a random battle, or random loot. While events are predetermined, random battles and loots are fully randomized and with an ever-changing and evolving pool of encounters. Within the hub, you may converse with the saleswoman and buy or sell items from her. The game features a very simplistic progression system, with battles focused on exploiting consumables and elemental weaknesses. The main aspect of it is to deliver a cautionary tale about hubris, expectations and duty through a fantasy lens.
Changelog
Spoiler
Version 2.0​
Infinite random encounters bug fixed;
Multiple visual elements updated;
Save slot amount decreased;
New items added, prices changed and stat boosts balanced;
Character sprites and battler sprites updated;
Combat now more in-depth while remaining simple;
New enemy and ally abilities added;
Enemy balancing updated, attack elements now more important;
Every enemy now has one or more unique abilities;
Aside from small tweaks, the scenario remains unchanged.
Version 1.1​
Enemy and currency balancing tweaks;
Fixed character standing picture remaining on screen after conversation.
Version 1.0​
June 16th, the game was released!

DOWNLOAD
Spoiler
This game is available for free over at Itch.io.
https://duskworks.itch.io/aporia-aegis-antechamber
This game was originally an entry for the
Toasty Jam
, an RPG Maker game jam hosted by Youtuber
ToastyTime
, where participants had the theme "Unnerving and Uncomfortable" to work with. It was developed over the course of 9 days and, as the community voting period wrapped up, it has now been updated with a post-jam 2.0 build which fully realizes the game in its original concept while maintaining the original story intact.
